title: El Metro
subtitle: The Subway
premise: You need to get from the airport to your hotel in Malasaña. The metro map looks like a spider's web. You take the wrong line and end up somewhere completely unexpected in the old city.
setting: Madrid Metro system. Starts at Aeropuerto T4 station, ends up at Gran Vía by mistake. Long fluorescent corridors, the smell of warm air from the tunnels.

characters.name: Carmen
characters.personality: Brisk, seen it all before, but warms up when travelers try their Spanish

characters.name: Javier
characters.role: Daily commuter, mid-30s, reads his phone constantly
characters.personality: Distracted but ultimately helpful when someone genuinely needs it

arc: Lost at the information booth → Carmen explains (confusingly) → You get on the wrong train → Javier notices your confusion → He walks you to the right platform → You arrive, shake hands
